subject.title: fix(openai): reject truncated OAuth image response streams

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally replace OAuth image-stream empty/partial apparent success with the new explicit terminal-stream errors after reviewing redacted OAuth-path evidence?
rationale: This is a deliberate public provider failure-contract change on a protected draft PR; source and upstream behavior support the implementation, but maintainer intent is required for the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept explicit terminal failures
options.body: Approve the provider-local change after reviewing OAuth-path evidence that normal completed image generation remains successful.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different error shape, retry policy, or user-facing recovery behavior for truncated OAuth streams.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit terminal failures
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-local change after reviewing OAuth-path evidence that normal completed image generation remains successful.

likelyOwner.reason: The current author is the best available routing point for the direct Codex contract evidence and any requested proof, while the protected label preserves human approval.
